Metadata.Title: City Shrouded in Shadow
Metadata.Name: No GPU Stall Timeout
Metadata.Note: FUN_004330b0 spins on a GPU label and, after 10,000,000 checks, prints 'Stall during rendering' and stops at int 0x41. On a PC CPU that is ~10 ms, shorter than the port's GPU translation needs when new shaders appear (an item handed to the player): the jne at 0x43312b becomes a jmp, so it waits for the label.
Metadata.Author: kyoei_toshi_pc

Metadata.Title: City Shrouded in Shadow
Metadata.Name: Skip Constants For Unbound Shader
Metadata.Note: FUN_0045eaa0..FUN_0045f3c0 (seven, one per resource kind) write data for a shader stage through the stage's bound shader (ctx+0xc180+stage*8). NPCs freed in the frame (after a QTE, Ev_201_C076; on Continue after a death) leave it NULL: faults at 0x45ec82 and 0x45f4d2. In each, the 49 bytes after 'test r14d,r14d / je exit' are re-encoded with the same effect plus 'test r13,r13 / je exit'.
Metadata.Author: kyoei_toshi_pc

Metadata.Title: City Shrouded in Shadow
Metadata.Name: Skip Unloaded NPC List Entries
Metadata.Note: FUN_0023be90 (and its two copies FUN_00238xxx, FUN_0023bxxx) read entries of the list at this+0x228 (count at +0x230) in three places each without a NULL check; while a stage loads an entry can be NULL (faults at 0x23c53b, 0x23cd42 and 0x2386eb at 30 FPS). The copies' six stubs are at 0x124a000-0x124a0c1, in the unused pages the loader now maps with the code segment (prepare.load_end). Each load jumps to a 32-byte stub in 0x433131-0x433191, a cave in the stall-timeout path that 'No GPU Stall Timeout' makes dead (its jmp is repeated here so this patch stands alone): a NULL entry goes to that loop's next item (0x23ccb7, 0x23ce50, 0x23c28e), else the original test, and back.
Metadata.Author: kyoei_toshi_pc

Metadata.Title: City Shrouded in Shadow
Metadata.Name: Skip Draw State For Unbound Shader
Metadata.Note: FUN_0045d060 commits draw state per shader stage; each stage's block starts with 'cmpb $0, ctx+0xc250+stage' (dirty) and 'je skip', then reads the stage's shader (ctx+0xc180+stage*8) and dereferences it. Skipping a cutscene left stage 2 NULL: fault at 0x45dc7d. Each of the seven cmpb becomes a call to a 21-byte stub that also sets ZF when the shader is NULL, so the existing je skips the block. Another thread can clear the shader during a block (fault at 0x45ddf5 on a re-read): each of the twelve re-reads inside the blocks jumps to a stub that leaves for the block's end when it is NULL (stubs 0x124a0c1-0x124a1c9). Stubs: 0x433191 and 0x4331a6 (the dead stall path; that jmp is repeated here) and 0x1249f70-0x1249fd9 (the rest of the code segment's last page).
Metadata.Author: kyoei_toshi_pc

Metadata.Title: City Shrouded in Shadow
Metadata.Name: Skip Bad Submesh Indices
Metadata.Note: FUN_0049fce0 walks an index array (this+0x60) into 0x348-byte elements (this+0x58). In the driving chapter an index read 0x3f800000 (1.0f), twice at the same place: fault at 0x49fdd4. The index load at 0x49fdb6 jumps to a stub at 0x124a1d0 that skips the entry (loop's next item, 0x49fe22) when the index is above 0xffff.
Metadata.Author: kyoei_toshi_pc
